Title: Garlic Roasted Chicken & Potatoes (Facebook Reel)
Instructions: Add the halved baby potatoes to a large baking dish. Add the minced garlic, olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, dried oregano (or thyme), salt, and black pepper. Toss well to coat.
Nestle the chicken pieces among the potatoes. Brush or spoon some of the seasoned oil from the pan over the chicken.
Add the sliced red chilli pepper if using.
Roast uncovered for 50–60 minutes, turning the chicken halfway through, until golden and cooked through.
If you want extra crispiness, grill/broil for 3–5 minutes at the end (watch closely).
Sprinkle with fresh herbs before serving.
Customizations: Add veg: onions, carrots, or bell peppers roast well alongside the potatoes.
More lemony: add lemon wedges to the tray and squeeze over before serving.
Swap seasoning: use rosemary instead of oregano/thyme.
OptionalInstructions: If using chicken thighs, check doneness earlier as cook time can vary by size.
Leftovers reheat well in the oven or air fryer to keep the potatoes crisp.
ServingSuggestions: Serve straight from the pan with a simple green salad.
Serve with crusty bread to mop up the juices.
